BiblicalUsage: Pashach means to tear in pieces. It appears once, in Lamentations 3:11, where the afflicted man says God has turned aside his ways and pulled him in pieces, and made him desolate.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lamentations lets the torn man say so plainly, and the God who tore him is the same God he turns back to in the next chapter.
